contract: design-contract.md: admin operations journal with exact ID/action/date filtering, atomic redacted state comparisons and explicit unattributed actors.

accessibility.evidence: Zero axe WCAG2 A/AA and WCAG2.1 AA violations on desktop and mobile with comparison open. Enter toggles native details; keyboard focus has a visible 3px solid outline. Reduced motion enabled.

responsive.evidence: Desktop and mobile rendered checks show no document overflow. Filters stack; IDs wrap; before/after labels remain readable on mobile.

loading.evidence: A delayed loopback fixture visibly rendered Loading recorded changes before the result arrived; loading-mobile.png.

empty.evidence: No matching changes and View all history are visible for an empty filtered page.

error.evidence: Fixture 503 renders The audit history couldn’t load with Reload history; no invented empty data.

partial.reason: Each page reads one event query, with no independent summary or optional data source. Failed reads show the explicit error state.

success.evidence: 25 event rows, six action categories, before/after disclosure, exact ID links, role filter and page 2/newer navigation exercised.

permission.evidence: Viewer session shows administrator access boundary. Endpoint tests deny anonymous, ordinary and demoted users. Fixture endpoint denial also renders access-needed feedback.

renderedEvidence.observation: Admin navigation, title, scoped privacy message, labelled filters and first event.
Actor/target/subject references and redacted three-column state comparison.
Navigation and filter controls fit a mobile viewport.
Stacked identity references and labelled before/after comparisons fit the narrow card.
Route loading state during delayed server response.
Empty results explain filtering and offer full history.
Unavailable API has a reload action.
Non-admin session sees access-needed boundary and dashboard return.
